text.hi: किताब: गांधीजी की कौन सी बातें तुम अपनाना चाहोगे? चुनो: self-help (अपना काम ख़ुद करना), simplicity (सादगी), truthfulness (सच्चाई), non-violence (अहिंसा), vegetarianism (शाकाहार)।
text.hinglish: Kitaab: Gandhiji ki kaun si baatein tum apnaana chahoge? Chuno: self-help (apna kaam khud karna), simplicity (saadgi), truthfulness (sachchaai), non-violence (ahinsa), vegetarianism (shaakaahaar).
text.en: The book: which of Gandhiji's ways would you like to follow? Choose from: self-help, simplicity, truthfulness, non-violence, vegetarianism.
